label: Season of KDE
source: MediaWiki source of community.kde.org/SoK/Ideas/<year> for 2017-2026, held at public/data/kde-archive.json (`ideas`)
note: One row per idea the Season of KDE ideas page PROPOSES, with the mentor KDE names on that idea. These are not accepted or completed projects - the unit is "proposed ideas" for exactly that reason. 23 wiki furniture line(s) ("General information", "Information for mentees", "Sample project", "Your Own Idea") and 20 section heading(s) repeated as rows were dropped, and "Project:"/"===" wiki syntax was stripped from the rest; an idea the page marks slot-filled or slot-taken keeps its title and says so in `b`, because that is KDE's own statement about the row. The 25 accepted Season of KDE 2026 proposals this site read from community.kde.org/SoK/2026/StatusReport (data/raw/kde.json) are deliberately NOT merged into this shard: an accepted proposal is a different kind of record from a proposed idea and the shard has one unit. Where a year's page lists no ideas at all (2026's page carries only the information sections), this shard has no rows for that year.
